title: Toronto police officer charged by SIU in connection with alleged suicide of 19-year-old man in High Park
article: A Toronto police officer has been charged by the province's Special Investigations Unit (SIU) in connection with an incident in High Park in February in which a 19-year-old man allegedly died by suicide.

The SIU, in a June 23 media release, said its investigation determined that around 2 p.m. on Feb. 2, a man sought the assistance of a police officer regarding a suicide attempt by the teen in High Park. The young man was pronounced dead at approximately 3:30 p.m. that afternoon.

As a result of its investigation, the SIU said its director, Tony Loparco, "has reasonable grounds to believe the police officer committed the criminal offences of criminal negligence causing death and failing to provide the necessaries of life."
As the case is before the courts, the SIU said it would not be making any further comment in consideration of the fair trial interests of the accused.
Const. Kyle Upjohn is scheduled to appear before the Ontario Court of Justice on Aug. 4.
The SIU is an arm's length agency that investigates reports involving police where there has been death, serious injury or allegations of sexual assault.
